purpose: Deterministic test-only mutations derived from real source snapshots; not observations, corrections, or alternative published datasets.
application: For each case, override exactly the named raw source for a candidate preparation/validation test. All other inputs remain the original manifest-pinned files. The default fixture_build.py deliberately accepts only the unmodified manifest and does not load these variants.

cases.mutation: Remove every vehicle category row for BFS 2401 Egerkingen; other rows are byte-value identical.
cases.sql: SELECT * FROM vehicles WHERE GDENR<>2401 ORDER BY GDENR,FZART_CD
cases.expected_gate: Vehicle municipality coverage fails: BFS 2401 is missing. Do not substitute zero and issue an apparently complete canton ratio.

cases.mutation: Set all demographic counts in the one BFS 2401 Egerkingen row to zero, preserving its labels and every other row. This keeps row-level additive identities consistent.
cases.sql: SELECT BFS_Nr,Gemeinde,Bezirk,CASE WHEN BFS_Nr=2401 THEN 0::BIGINT ELSE Total END AS Total, CASE WHEN BFS_Nr=2401 THEN 0::BIGINT ELSE Total_Maennlich END AS Total_Maennlich, CASE WHEN BFS_Nr=2401 THEN 0::BIGINT ELSE Total_Weiblich END AS Total_Weiblich, CASE WHEN BFS_Nr=2401 THEN 0::BIGINT ELSE Total_SchweizerInnen END AS Total_SchweizerInnen, CASE WHEN BFS_Nr=2401 THEN 0::BIGINT ELSE Total_AuslaenderInnen END AS Total_AuslaenderInnen, CASE WHEN BFS_Nr=2401 THEN 0::BIGINT ELSE Alter_0_bis_19 END AS Alter_0_bis_19, CASE WHEN BFS_Nr=2401 THEN 0::BIGINT ELSE Alter_20_bis_39 END AS Alter_20_bis_39, CASE WHEN BFS_Nr=2401 THEN 0::BIGINT ELSE Alter_40_bis_64 END AS Alter_40_bis_64, CASE WHEN BFS_Nr=2401 THEN 0::BIGINT ELSE Alter_65_bis_79 END AS Alter_65_bis_79, CASE WHEN BFS_Nr=2401 THEN 0::BIGINT ELSE Alter_80_und_mehr END AS Alter_80_und_mehr FROM population_age ORDER BY BFS_Nr
cases.expected_gate: A vehicle/population ratio for BFS 2401 is undefined because the denominator is zero; report a distinct reason, never infinity or an invented zero ratio.

cases.mutation: Append an exact second copy of the actual BFS 2401 Egerkingen row.
cases.sql: SELECT * FROM population_age UNION ALL SELECT * FROM population_age WHERE BFS_Nr=2401 ORDER BY BFS_Nr
cases.expected_gate: Population key uniqueness fails before model activation. A source with duplicate report_year/geo_version/municipality_id may not be used as a denominator.
